notes: Two streaming features. (1) Dev Logs now has sub-tabs: the existing YouTube videos, plus a Live on Kick tab that embeds the official Kick player for kick.com/fleshmarket, with a Follow-on-Kick link. (2) A streaming OBS overlay, obs-stream-anchor.html: a 1920x1080 broadcast desk with a left rail (Mr. Flesh brain relay + voice waveform over a live market-movers panel), a framed GAME window in the middle for a capture, and a Kick chat column on the right that auto-embeds chat via chat.kick.cx (a third-party widget, because Kick blocks iframing its own popout; ?chat=0 falls back to an OBS browser source). Bottom ticker weaves funnel calls to action to FLESHMARKET.IO. Reads the same guest WebSocket feed the news anchor uses. The facecam attempts mic capture on load, so with OBS launched using --enable-media-stream --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream the waveform tracks your voice; ?mic=0 forces procedural. Client only, no server or DB change, hard-refresh to see the tab. Carries 1.1.9.7 and earlier.
